title: chore(core, plugin-security): isFederatedObject is spelled four times; every copy should read the spec predicate platformProvisionsStorage
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKZzp4DLtqiCkZZRM

Found while reviewing #31812 (PR #31846). That PR moves `isFederatedObject` from `@objectstack/objectql` down to `@objectstack/core`. After it lands, the question "is this object federated (ADR-0015 `external`)?" is answered in four places:

| copy | spelling |
|---|---|
| `packages/core/src/security/tenant-field.ts` (after #31846) | `schema?.external != null` |
| `packages/objectql/src/federated-object.ts` | re-exports the core binding (after #31846) |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/federated-phantom-anchors.ts:117` | `schema?.external != null`, its own copy |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/federated-phantom-anchors.ts:96` | `!platformProvisionsStorage(schema)` |

`@objectstack/spec/data`'s `platformProvisionsStorage` (`injected-system-column-provenance.ts:269`) is the predicate #7865's convergence map names as the one spelling. plugin-sharing already reads it. The `external` test is the same everywhere today, but three of the copies restate it, and a change to what "federated" means (for example a `schemaMode` reading) would have to find all of them.

## Ask

- `@objectstack/core`'s `isFederatedObject` returns `!platformProvisionsStorage(schema)`. `@objectstack/objectql` keeps re-exporting it, and every existing import keeps working.
- plugin-security drops its own copy and imports the core binding (it already depends on `@objectstack/core`).
- plugin-sharing imports the core binding too, or keeps reading the spec predicate directly; either is fine as long as no copy restates `external != null`.
- Pin: one test in core proves `isFederatedObject` and `!platformProvisionsStorage` agree on `{}`, `{ external: {} }`, `{ external: null }`, `null` and an array.

Accept: `git grep -n "external != null\|external == null" packages/core packages/objectql packages/plugins` finds no predicate copy outside the spec. Behaviour is unchanged, so this is a `patch` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Blocked-by: #31812 (PR #31846).
